info.name: Algod REST API. common search API

params.name: asset-id
params.description: Asset ID

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return. There could be additional pages even if the limit is not reached.

params.name: next
params.description: The next page of results. Use the next token provided by the previous results.

params.name: currency-greater-than
params.description: Results should have an amount greater than this value. MicroAlgos are the default currency unless an asset-id is provided, in which case the asset will be used.

params.name: include-all
params.description: Include all items including closed accounts, deleted applications, destroyed assets, opted-out asset holdings, and closed-out application localstates.

params.name: exclude
params.description: Exclude additional items such as asset holdings, application local data stored for this account, asset parameters created by this account, and application parameters created by this account.

params.name: currency-less-than
params.description: Results should have an amount less than this value. MicroAlgos are the default currency unless an asset-id is provided, in which case the asset will be used.

params.name: auth-addr
params.description: Include accounts configured to use this spending key.

params.name: round
params.description: Include results for the specified round. For performance reasons, this parameter may be disabled on some configurations. Using application-id or asset-id filters will return both creator and opt-in accounts. Filtering by include-all will return creator and opt-in accounts for deleted assets and accounts. Non-opt-in managers are not included in the results when asset-id is used.

params.description: When this is set to true, return only accounts whose participation status is currently online.

params.name: sig-type
params.description:
SigType filters just results using the specified type of signature:
* sig - Standard
* msig - MultiSig
* lsig - LogicSig

params.name: group-id
params.description: Lookup transactions by group ID. This field must be base64-encoded, and afterwards, base64 characters that are URL-unsafe (i.e. =, /, +) must be URL-encoded

params.name: txid
params.description: Lookup the specific transaction by ID.

params.name: address
params.description: Only include transactions with this address in one of the transaction fields.

params.name: address-role
params.description: Combine with the address parameter to define what type of address to search for.

params.name: exclude-close-to
params.description: Combine with address and address-role parameters to define what type of address to search for. The close to fields are normally treated as a receiver, if you would like to exclude them set this parameter to true.

params.name: rekey-to
params.description: Include results which include the rekey-to field.
